::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1867]  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MSS. Autogr. c.25 ff 268-9
:::

Dear [Miss Manning](people/person_2001.qmd),
I am sorry not to have been able sooner to answer you and tell you how much I like your [friend](people/person_175.qmd)’s [Stone cutter](other_books/otherbook_175.qmd), whom I shall most gladly have in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), though I am afraid it can hardly be before the end of the year, as though in the enlarged size of the Monthly Packet I can generally get a short self-contained story in every month, I am engaged a good deal in advance with them

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
